title: Top K Frequent Elements
hints: Count first: one dict pass gives (value -> frequency). Now the problem is 'k largest frequencies' over the distinct values, and sorting them is O(d log d).
A min-heap of size k over (frequency, value) pairs is O(d log k): push every distinct value, pop whenever the heap exceeds k. What survives is the top k.
Frequencies are integers in [1, n], so bucket them: buckets[f] holds the values with frequency f. Walk the buckets from n down to 1 until you have k values. That is O(n) with no comparisons at all.
